pages.text: Fields draw water three ways:$(li)$(thing)Rain:$() what doesn't run off a slope soaks in.$(li)$(thing)Seepage$() from nearby water: two blocks through sand, four through loam, five or more through silt, clay and peat.
$(li)$(thing)Capillary rise$() from a shallow water table.

The water table is shallow in valleys and near rivers and deep on hilltops, so lower slopes stay moist through dry spells.$(br2)Crops use water fastest when the weather is hot, dry and windy, and when they are fully grown.
$(thing)Rice$() grows best flooded: plant it with water directly beside the block. Other crops drown if the soil stays saturated for too long.
